description: See your Claude Code chats in real time and what each agent and subagent is doing. Reads local files only.
view.name: Panel
cfg.language.auto: Same as the editor (Spanish if VS Code is in Spanish, English otherwise)
cfg.claudeDir: Claude Code configuration directory. Empty = `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude`.
cfg.pollSeconds: How often, in seconds, the transcripts are re-read (new bytes only).
cfg.statsSeconds: How often, in seconds, today's totals are recalculated.
